I'm a Master of Business Analytics student at Monash University in Melbourne. Before moving into data, I worked in finance and founded my own clothing brand, Va&eacute; Lour.

Running a business showed me that numbers are only useful when people can understand them and act on them. On this blog, I explain research findings in plain language for readers without a statistics background.
